def evolved_p99(x, N, rank, world_size, num_devices,
                 cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    # x[i] = min(i, N-i)^2 = ((N - |2i - N|)/2)^2
    idx = torch.arange(N, device=x.device, dtype=x.dtype)
    d = (2 * idx - N).abs()
    m = (N - d) / 2
    out = m * m
    return out
